headline.zh:
指向 coding agent 之前
先验明端点能不能干活
headline.en:
Before you point your agent at it
know if it can actually make tool calls

sub.zh: 国产模型跑得起来，不等于 tool-calling 稳。ReadyGate 用一套校准探针打端点、坏了在请求级修好、最后给出 yes/no 证书。
sub.en: A running local CN model isn't the same as a stable tool-calling endpoint. ReadyGate probes with a calibrated suite, repairs breakage at the request level, and emits a single yes/no certificate.

body.zh: chat-template 没配对、tool-call JSON 拼坏了——ReadyGate 在请求级别修好，绝不改你的服务器配置文件。修完重验一遍，修没修好你看得见。
body.en: Mismatched chat-template, malformed tool-call JSON — ReadyGate fixes these at the request level, never touching your server config. It re-verifies after repair, so you see exactly what changed.

title.zh: 给国产模型校准的探针

body.zh: 不是 OpenAI 通用探测——探针集针对 Qwen3、DeepSeek V4、GLM-5.2、Kimi K3 的 tool-calling 协议逐一校准，覆盖单次调用、嵌套参数、多工具并发三层。
body.en: Not generic OpenAI probes — the suite is calibrated against Qwen3, DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.2, and Kimi K3 tool-calling protocols, covering single calls, nested arguments, and parallel tool use.

body.zh: 结果不是一句"能用"——是一张按层拆解的 AgentReadinessCertificate：哪层过、哪层修过、哪层还在断。可以存档、可以发给队友、可以进 CI 卡质量。
body.en: The result isn't just "works" — it's a per-layer AgentReadinessCertificate: which layers passed, which were repaired, which still fail. Archive it, share it with your team, gate your CI on it.
